# Quodex

> Know your limits. Own your resets.

Quodex is a lightweight tray companion that tracks ChatGPT usage limits, pooled capacity, and banked resets across accounts.

## Product

- [Quodex for Windows](https://quodex.app/windows): interactive Windows 11 landing and download
- [Quodex for macOS](https://quodex.app): original menu-bar app
- [Windows source](https://github.com/hxbib/quodex-windows)
- [macOS source](https://github.com/hxbib/Quodex)
- [Windows landing source](https://github.com/hxbib/quodex-windows-website)

## Notes

- Independent project, not affiliated with OpenAI.
- The Windows app stores sessions with DPAPI on the local PC. This website never stores ChatGPT credentials.
- License: MIT
